output.answer_markdown: IQVIA described 2024 as another year of strong operating results, with income from operations up over 11 percent and operating cash flow up over 26 percent from 2023 [1]. It said it ended the year with its highest ever total company remaining performance obligations, at approximately $33.5 billion as of December 31, 2024 [2]. Technology & Analytics Solutions revenue and profit growth improved in the second half of the year as clients increased their spending [3]. Research & Development Solutions also produced revenue and segment profit growth in 2024 [4], though it faced challenges in the latter half of 2024 that it expects to persist into 2025 but considers more short-term in nature [5]. On liquidity, IQVIA reported cash and cash equivalents of $1,702 million and $825 million drawn under its $2,000 million revolving credit facility at December 31, 2024 [6]. It stated it was in compliance with its financial covenants in all material respects and did not see material uncertainty about meeting them [7]. The passages do not give segment-level figures or describe Contract Sales & Medical Solutions trends.
